description: Add LRU eviction (bounded capacity) plus per-entry TTL expiry to an unbounded cache
prompts: src/lib.rs's Cache is an unbounded HashMap wrapper - get/put never evict anything. Turn it into an LRU cache with a TTL: Cache::new(capacity: usize, ttl: i64) takes a max size and a time-to-live in seconds. put(&mut self, key: &str, value: i32, now: i64) stores a value timestamped at `now`. get(&mut self, key: &str, now: i64) -> Option<i32> returns the value if present AND not expired (now - stored_at < ttl), else None - and an expired entry must be REMOVED the moment it's observed to be stale. Both get and put must refresh a key's recency. When put() would exceed `capacity`, evict the LEAST recently used entry (recency = most recent get OR put) before inserting the new one.
name: add_rust_lru_cache_with_ttl
